verdict.rationale: ChatGPT/Codex has official first-party documentation for MCP support: users can add official MCP servers (e.g., Context7 for docs, Figma, browser tools) to extend the agent, configuration is stored in config.toml, servers can be scoped per-project, and setup carries across clients without redoing it. This directly evidences 'connecting an agent via an official MCP server.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of MCP server usage and broader detail on the range of officially supported/verified servers beyond the Context7 example.
